user.title: Connect to Wopet Local Bridge
user.description: Install and start the Wopet Local Bridge app first. Camera credentials remain in the app configuration.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the bridge RTSP port. Confirm the app is running and the host and port are correct.

abort.already_configured: This bridge stream is already configured.

init.title: Wopet bridge connection and controls
init.description: The bridge host must be reachable from Home Assistant Core; do not use 127.0.0.1 on HAOS. Use the same private control token configured in the Wopet Local Bridge app.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the bridge RTSP port. Confirm the app is running and use the HAOS host address rather than 127.0.0.1.
